question: Should OpenClaw adopt signed sharded hosted catalogs as a core protocol now, and what merge/activation sequence is approved across the standard-DSSE and default-trust-profile prerequisites?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally coupled to two open rollout components and a producer-side signing deployment; source-level review cannot determine the intended compatibility and activation policy alone.

options.title: Sequence and prove the rollout
options.body: Land or otherwise approve the DSSE and trust-profile prerequisites first, then require end-to-end signed-root/shard proof before reviewing this branch for merge.

options.title: Pause the protocol expansion
options.body: Defer this branch until the ClawHub signer, public-key profile, and long-term catalog-sharding ownership are ready for a coordinated release.

recommendation.title: Sequence and prove the rollout
recommendation.body: Land or otherwise approve the DSSE and trust-profile prerequisites first, then require end-to-end signed-root/shard proof before reviewing this branch for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the coupled implementation stack and can provide the integration evidence needed for the owner decision.
